title: Infinity Night Vision
description: This project let player give/clear effect of night vision.
body:
# Infinity Night Vision

![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.0.1-blue)
![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.9+-yellow)

## Introduction

Infinity Night Vision is a datapack that allows you to give yourself effect of night vision.

## Features

- **No OP required** — survival players can toggle via `/trigger`
- **UI included** — works with *Scoreboard ID* datapack for clickable panel
- **Lightweight** — predicate-based, no wasted ticks
- **mc 1.21.9+** tested

## Requirements

- Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.9 or higher
- Datapack format version 88-107
- Dependency: [Scoreboard ID](https://modrinth.com/datapack/scoreboard-id)

## Installation

1. Download the datapack file
2. Place it in your world's datapacks folder:

    ```path
    <world_folder>/datapacks/Scoreboard ID - 1.21.9+.zip
    ```

3. Reload datapacks in-game:

    ```mcfunction
    /reload
    ```

## Usage

### Open

```mcfunction
/trigger night_vision set 1
```

### Close

```mcfunction
/trigger night_vision set -1
```

### Access Help Menu

Open the pause menu and navigate to the Server Tools menu to access the help dialog with all available commands.
